checks.evidence: Original Main Floor Thermostat issue shows captured temperature 68 F, minimum 80 F, observed duration, opening time, one acknowledgment and one Details; existing acknowledgment retained.
Opened exact thermostat issue pause form; duration required and submit disabled. Closed without applying.
Original Front Hallway battery shows its single Unavailable reading directly, Not monitored separately, one Details, Home Assistant and History links.
Front Hallway device shows availability and coverage, two unavailable monitored entities, one related issue and one Details.
Location grouping, search, independent expansion/selection and wrapped Front Hallway device metadata inspected on live installation.

Front Hallway Illuminance separates Unavailable in Home Assistant from availability monitoring. View history opens inline and reports no retained problems for this source, without changing monitoring.
All eight saved policies load with existing enabled states and exclusions; Home Interior Temperature Monitoring remains below 80 F for 10 seconds.
All six notification definitions load with original Mike Companion App assignments and saved timing; no send test performed.

Live original thermostat dialog inspected at verified 390x844 CSS pixels; no horizontal overflow, wrapped title, readable condition and acknowledgment, reachable actions and Details with 10-second required duration. Physical Safari not tested.
Edit policy opens saved sensor scope, enabled state, 80 F lower-only bound and exact 10 seconds; Back to issue returns to the original compact issue without saving.

limits: Physical iOS Safari remains untested; phone review uses responsive Chrome.
